Hi, um, thanks for asking. I’m actually reaching out because I’m in a bit of a tough spot right now. I’ve been a loyal customer for a long time, and I really love shopping with you guys, but I recently ran into some unexpected financial trouble. It’s honestly been really stressful, and I’m just trying to figure out how to get back on my feet. 

So, I was wondering if there’s any way I could cancel or return any recent orders I’ve made? I just need to free up some funds wherever I can. I’m sorry if this is a hassle—I just don’t know what else to do right now.

Thank you so much for understanding. I really appreciate you being patient with me—I know I’m probably not the only one going through something like this, but it still feels overwhelming. 

I actually have two emails that I might have used for my orders: silva7872@example.com and amelia.silva7872@example.com. I’m not sure which one is linked to my most recent purchases, but hopefully that helps! 

Let me know if you need anything else to find my account. I just want to make sure I do this right.

Thank you so much for finding my account so quickly. Honestly, I’d really appreciate it if you could just review all my recent orders. I’m feeling a bit overwhelmed and I can’t even remember all the order numbers off the top of my head right now. If it’s possible to look at everything I’ve ordered recently and let me know which ones can still be canceled or returned, that would be a huge help.

I’m just trying to do whatever I can to get through this rough patch, so any flexibility or advice you can offer would mean a lot to me. Thank you again for being so understanding.

Thank you so much for breaking that down for me—it really helps to see everything listed out like that. Honestly, with everything going on, I’d like to cancel both of the pending orders (#W4836353 and #W7342738) if that’s possible. The reason is just that I can’t afford them anymore, so I guess “no longer needed” fits best.

As for the delivered orders (#W4597054 and #W7773202), I’d like to return everything from both of those if I’m allowed to. I haven’t even opened some of the packages yet because I was already starting to worry about my finances. 

Please let me know what I need to do next, and if there’s anything else you need from me. Thank you again for being so patient—I know I’m asking for a lot.

Yes, that’s exactly what I want to do—please cancel both of the pending orders for the reason “no longer needed,” and I’d like to return all the items from both delivered orders as well. A refund to my gift card is totally fine.

Thank you so much for helping me with this. I really can’t tell you how much I appreciate your support right now.

Thank you so much for taking care of everything so quickly. I really appreciate your kindness and understanding—it honestly means a lot to me, especially right now. I’ll keep an eye out for the return instructions in my email.

If I have any other questions, I’ll be sure to reach out. Thanks again for all your help! ###STOP###
